items.source: RuntimeException that implements ErrorResponse to expose an HTTP status, response headers, and a body formatted as an RFC 9457 ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 实现 ErrorResponse 的 RuntimeException，用于暴露 HTTP 状态、响应头以及格式化为 RFC 9457 ProblemDetail 的正文。

items.source: Subclass of BeanDefinitionStoreException indicating an invalid override attempt: typically registering a new definition for the same bean name while DefaultListableBeanFactory.isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding() is false.
items.translation: `BeanDefinitionStoreException` 的子类，表示无效的覆盖尝试：通常是在注册与同一 bean 名称对应的新定义时，而 `DefaultListableBeanFactory.isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding()` 为 `false`。

items.source: Subclass of ErrorResponseException that accepts a "reason", and by default maps that to the "detail" of the ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 继承自ErrorResponseException的子类，它接受一个 "reason" 参数，并默认将其映射到ProblemDetail的"detail"。

items.source: Encoder and Decoder abstractions to convert between a reactive stream of bytes and Java objects.
items.translation: Encoder 和 Decoder 抽象用于在字节反应式流与 Java 对象之间进行转换。

items.source: Wrapper for the native IOException (or similar) when a Serializer or Deserializer failed.
items.translation: 原生 IOException（或类似异常）的包装器，当 Serializer 或 Deserializer 失败时抛出。

items.source: Thrown by HttpMessageConverter implementations when the HttpMessageConverter.read(Class, HttpInputMessage) method fails.

items.source: Thrown by HttpMessageConverter implementations when the HttpMessageConverter.write(T, MediaType, HttpOutputMessage) method fails.

items.source: RuntimeException to be thrown in case of JNDI lookup failures, in particular from code that does not declare JNDI's checked NamingException: for example, from Spring's JndiObjectTargetSource.

items.source: Exception thrown when a BindMarkersFactoryResolver cannot resolve a BindMarkersFactory.

items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source: Support classes for the open source scheduler Quartz, allowing to set up Quartz Schedulers, JobDetails and Triggers as beans in a Spring context.
items.translation: 支持开源调度器 Quartz 的类，允许在 Spring 上下文中将 Quartz Scheduler、JobDetails 和 Triggers 配置为 Bean。

items.source: Exception to be thrown from a FactoryBean's getObject() method if the bean is not fully initialized yet, for example because it is involved in a circular reference.
items.translation: 如果 Bean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则从 FactoryBean 的getObject()方法抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which it cannot find a definition.
items.translation: 当请求一个无法找到定义的 Bean 实例时，BeanFactory 会抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a BeanFactory is asked for a bean instance for which multiple matching candidates have been found when only one matching bean was expected.
items.translation: 当请求一个 `BeanFactory` 的 Bean 实例时，如果预期只找到一个匹配的 Bean，但发现了多个匹配候选者，则抛出异常。

items.source: Root of the hierarchy of data access exceptions discussed in Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development.
items.translation: 数据访问异常层次结构的根，在《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》<a href="https://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/detail/-/0764543857/">中讨论。

items.source: Exception thrown when we cannot locate an instance of an MBeanServer, or when more than one instance is found.
items.translation: 当无法定位 MBeanServer 的实例，或找到多个实例时抛出异常。

items.source: Thrown by the JmxAttributeSource when it encounters incorrect metadata on a managed resource or one of its methods.
items.translation: 由 `JmxAttributeSource` 抛出，当它在托管资源或其某个方法上遇到不正确的元数据时。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when a method argument fails validation perhaps as a result of @Valid style validation, or perhaps because it is required.
items.translation: 当方法参数验证失败时抛出的异常，这可能是由于 `@Valid` 风格的验证导致，也可能是因为该参数为必填项。

items.source: JPA-specific subclass of UncategorizedDataAccessException, for JPA system errors that do not match any concrete org.springframework.dao exceptions.
items.translation: JPA 专用的 UncategorizedDataAccessException 子类，用于那些无法匹配任何具体 org.springframework.dao 异常的 JPA 系统错误。

items.source: Exception thrown to indicate that a Content-Type is not supported.
items.translation: 抛出异常以指示不支持的Content-Type。

items.source: as of 6.0.3 since it is not in use within core JDBC/ORM support
items.translation: 自 6.0.3 版本起，由于核心 JDBC/ORM 支持中未使用它。

items.source: Core Spring AOP interfaces, built on AOP Alliance AOP interoperability interfaces.
items.translation: 核心 Spring AOP 接口，基于 AOP Alliance AOP 互操作性接口构建。

items.source: Classes enabling AspectJ 5 @Annotated classes to be used in Spring AOP.
items.translation: 使 AspectJ 5 @Annotated 类能够在 Spring AOP 中使用的类。

items.source: This package contains interfaces and classes for manipulating Java beans.
items.translation: 该包包含用于操作 Java 对象的接口和类。

items.source: The core package implementing Spring's lightweight Inversion of Control (IoC) container.
items.translation: 实现 Spring 轻量级控制反转（IoC）容器的核心包。

items.source: Support infrastructure for bean definition parsing.
items.translation: 支持 Bean 定义解析的基础设施。

items.source:
This package builds on the beans package to add support for
message sources and for the Observer design pattern, and the
ability for application objects to obtain resources using a
consistent API.
items.translation: 该包在 beans 包的基础上增加了消息源和观察者设计模式的支持，并允许应用程序对象通过一致的 API 获取资源。

items.source:
Core support package for annotations, meta-annotations, and merged
annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 用于注解、元注解以及带有属性覆盖的合并注解的核心支持包。

items.source: Type conversion system API.
items.translation: 类型转换系统 API。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's serializer abstraction.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 序列化抽象的支持类。

items.source:
Exception hierarchy enabling sophisticated error handling independent
of the data access approach in use.
items.translation: 支持复杂错误处理的异常层次结构，该处理独立于所使用的数据访问方法。

items.source: Provides an HttpMessageConverter abstraction to convert between Java objects and HTTP input/output messages.
items.translation: 提供 HttpMessageConverter 抽象，用于在 Java 对象和 HTTP 输入/输出消息之间进行转换。

items.source:
The classes in this package make JDBC easier to use and
reduce the likelihood of common errors.
items.translation: 该包中的类使 JDBC 更易使用，并降低了常见错误的发生概率。

items.source: Provides a strategy for looking up JDBC DataSources by name.
items.translation: 提供按名称查找 JDBC DataSource 的策略。

items.source: Abstraction for handling fields of SQLXML data type.
items.translation: 用于处理 SQLXML 数据类型的字段的抽象。

items.source:
This package contains integration classes for JMS,
allowing for Spring-style JMS access.
items.translation: 该包包含用于 JMS 的集成类，允许以 Spring 风格访问 JMS。

items.source:
Provides a PlatformTransactionManager implementation for a single
JMS ConnectionFactory, and a SingleConnectionFactory adapter.
items.translation: 为单个 JMS ConnectionFactory 提供 PlatformTransactionManager 实现，并提供 SingleConnectionFactory 适配器。

items.source:
Message listener adapter mechanism that delegates to target listener
methods, converting messages to appropriate message content types
(such as String or byte array) that get passed into listener methods.
items.translation: 消息监听器适配器机制，该机制将消息委托给目标监听器方法，并将消息转换为适当的消息内容类型（如 String 或字节数组），这些内容类型会被传递给监听器方法。

items.source:
Provides a MessageConverter abstraction to convert
between Java objects and JMS messages.
items.translation: 提供 MessageConverter 抽象，用于在 Java 对象和 JMS 消息之间进行转换。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's JMS framework.
items.translation: Spring JMS 框架的支持类。

items.source:
This package contains Spring's JMX support, which includes registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans as well as access to remote JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包包含 Spring 的 JMX 支持，其中包括将 Spring 管理的 Bean 注册为 JMX MBean，以及访问远程 JMX MBean。

items.source: Provides support for accessing remote MBean resources.
items.translation: 提供访问远程 MBean 资源的支持。

items.source:
This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包提供对 Spring 管理的 Bean 作为 JMX MBean 进行声明式创建和注册。

items.source:
Provides generic JMX metadata classes and basic support for reading
JMX metadata in a provider-agnostic manner.
items.translation: 提供通用的 JMX 元数据类，并支持以与提供者无关的方式读取 JMX 元数据。

items.source:
Provides supporting infrastructure to allow Spring-created MBeans
to send JMX notifications.
items.translation: 提供支持基础设施，允许 Spring 创建的 MBean 发送 JMX 通知。

items.source:
The classes in this package make JNDI easier to use,
facilitating the accessing of configuration stored in JNDI,
and provide useful superclasses for JNDI access classes.
items.translation: 该包中的类使 JNDI 更易使用，便于访问存储在 JNDI 中的配置，并为 JNDI 访问类提供有用的超类。

items.source: Spring's generic mail infrastructure.
items.translation: Spring 的通用邮件基础设施。

items.source: Support for working with messaging APIs and protocols.
items.translation: 支持与消息 API 和协议协作。

items.source: Provides support for message conversion.
items.translation: 提供消息转换支持。

items.source: Defines interfaces and implementation classes for messaging templates.
items.translation: 定义消息模板的接口和实现类。

items.source: Support classes for working with annotated message-handling methods.
items.translation: 支持使用注解的消息处理方法的工作类。

items.source: Common infrastructure for invoking message handler methods.
items.translation: 用于调用消息处理器方法的通用基础设施。

items.source:
Support classes for handling messages from simple messaging protocols
(like STOMP).
items.translation: 用于处理简单消息协议（如 STOMP）消息的支持类。

items.source: Generic support for simple messaging protocols (like STOMP).
items.translation: 支持简单消息协议（如 STOMP）的通用功能。

items.source: Root package for Spring's O/R Mapping integration classes.
items.translation: Spring 的 O/R 映射集成类的根包。

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source: Root package for Spring's O/X Mapping integration classes.
items.translation: Spring 的 O/X 映射集成类的根包。

items.source:
The classes in this package make R2DBC easier to use and
reduce the likelihood of common errors.
items.translation: 该包中的类使 R2DBC 更易使用，并降低了常见错误的发生概率。

items.source: Provides a strategy for looking up R2DBC ConnectionFactories by name.
items.translation: 提供按名称查找 R2DBC ConnectionFactory 的策略。

items.source: Classes providing an abstraction over SQL bind markers.
items.translation: 提供对 SQL 绑定标记抽象的类。

items.source:
General exceptions for Spring's scheduling support,
independent of any specific scheduling system.
items.translation: Spring 调度支持的一般异常，独立于任何特定的调度系统。

items.source: Core interfaces for Spring's scripting support.
items.translation: Spring 脚本支持的核心接口。
Spring 的核心事务管理 API（独立于任何特定的事务管理系统）；Spring 事务基础设施的异常层次结构；以及事务管理器、定义和状态接口。

items.source:
Common, generic interfaces that define minimal boundary points
between Spring's web infrastructure and other framework modules.
items.translation: 定义 Spring Web 基础设施与其他框架模块之间最小边界点的通用、通用接口。

items.source: This package contains classes used to determine the requested the media types in a request.
items.translation: 该包包含用于确定请求中请求的媒体类型的类。

items.source: Support classes for web data binding.
items.translation: 支持 Web 数据绑定的类。

items.source: Core package of the client-side web support.
items.translation: 客户端 Web 支持的核心包。

items.source: Support classes for annotation-based handler method processing.
items.translation: 支持基于注解的处理方法处理的辅助类。

items.source: Multipart resolution framework for handling file uploads.
items.translation: 用于处理文件上传的多部分解析框架。

items.source: Provides a foundation for both the reactive client and server subpackages.
items.translation: 为 reactive client 和 server 子包提供基础。

items.source: Support classes for serving static resources.
items.translation: 用于提供静态资源的辅助类。

items.source: Core interfaces and classes for Spring's generic, reactive web support.
items.translation: Spring 通用响应式 Web 支持的核心接口和类。

items.source: Server-side abstractions for WebSocket interactions.
items.translation: WebSocket 交互的服务器端抽象。

items.source: Top-level SockJS types.
items.translation: 顶层 SockJS 类型。

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an AOP invocation failed
because of misconfiguration or unexpected runtime issues.
items.translation: 因配置错误或意外的运行时问题导致 AOP 调用失败时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Extension of AopConfigException thrown when trying to perform
an advisor generation operation on a class that is not an
AspectJ annotation-style aspect.
items.translation: 抛出 `AopConfigException` 扩展，当尝试对非 AspectJ 注解风格的类执行顾问生成操作时。

items.source: Exception that gets thrown on illegal AOP configuration arguments.
items.translation: 在非法的 AOP 配置参数上抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when instantiation of a bean failed.
items.translation: 实例化 Bean 失败时抛出异常。

items.source:
Abstract superclass for all exceptions thrown in the beans package
and subpackages.
items.translation: beans 包及其子包中抛出的所有异常的抽象父类。

items.source: Exception thrown when no suitable editor or converter can be found for a bean property.
items.translation: 找不到适合 Bean 属性的编辑器或转换器时抛出异常。

items.source:
Thrown on an unrecoverable problem encountered in the
beans packages or sub-packages, for example, bad class or field.
items.translation: 在 beans 包或其子包中遇到无法恢复的问题时抛出，例如类或字段错误。

items.source: Exception thrown when referring to an invalid bean property.
items.translation: 引用无效的 Bean 属性时抛出异常。

items.source:
Thrown when a bean property getter or setter method throws an exception,
analogous to an InvocationTargetException.
items.translation: 当 Bean 属性的 getter 或 setter 方法抛出异常时抛出，类似于 InvocationTargetException。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to get the value of a property
that isn't readable, because there's no getter method.
items.translation: 在尝试获取没有 getter 方法的不可读属性的值时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to set the value of a property that
is not writable (typically because there is no setter method).
items.translation: 在尝试设置不可写属性的值时抛出异常（通常是因为没有 setter 方法）。

items.source:
Exception thrown when navigation of a valid nested property
path encounters a NullPointerException.
items.translation: 在导航有效的嵌套属性路径时抛出空指针异常。

items.source:
Superclass for exceptions related to a property access,
such as type mismatch or invocation target exception.
items.translation: 与属性访问相关的异常的超类，例如类型不匹配或调用目标异常。

items.source: Combined exception, composed of individual PropertyAccessException instances.
items.translation: 组合异常，由多个 PropertyAccessException 实例组成。

items.source: Exception thrown on a type mismatch when trying to set a bean property.
items.translation: 在尝试设置 Bean 属性时，因类型不匹配而抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a BeanFactory encounters an error when
attempting to create a bean from a bean definition.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 尝试从 BeanDefinition 创建 Bean 时遇到错误而抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown in case of a bean being requested despite
bean creation currently not being allowed (for example, during
the shutdown phase of a bean factory).
items.translation: 在请求 Bean 但当前不允许创建 Bean 的情况下抛出异常（例如，在 BeanFactory 的关闭阶段）。

items.source: Exception thrown in case of a reference to a bean that's currently in creation.
items.translation: 在引用当前正在创建的 Bean 时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a BeanFactory encounters an invalid bean definition:
for example, in case of incomplete or contradictory bean metadata.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 遇到无效的 Bean 定义时抛出异常：例如，在 Bean 元数据不完整或相互矛盾的情况下。

items.source: Exception that indicates an expression evaluation attempt having failed.
items.translation: 表示表达式求值尝试失败的异常。

items.source:
Exception that a bean implementation is suggested to throw if its own
factory-aware initialization code fails.
items.translation: 如果 Bean 自身的工厂感知初始化代码失败，建议抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean instance has been requested for
a bean definition which has been marked as abstract.
items.translation: 当请求一个被标记为抽象的 Bean 定义的 Bean 实例时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean is not a factory, but a user tries to get
at the factory for the given bean name.
items.translation: 当用户尝试获取给定 Bean 名称的工厂，但该 Bean 并非工厂时抛出的异常。

items.source: Thrown when a bean doesn't match the expected type.
items.translation: 抛出当 Bean 不匹配预期类型时。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the BeanFactory cannot load the specified class
of a given bean.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 无法加载给定 bean 的指定类时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean depends on other beans or simple properties
that were not specified in the bean factory definition, although
dependency checking was enabled.
items.translation: 当 Bean 依赖于未在 Bean 工厂定义中指定的其他 Bean 或简单属性，且启用了依赖检查时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean definition reader encounters an error
during the parsing process.
items.translation: 当 Bean 定义读取器在解析过程中遇到错误时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when the validation of a bean definition failed.
items.translation: 当 Bean 定义验证失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown during application context initialization.
items.translation: 应用程序上下文初始化期间抛出异常。

items.source:
General error that indicates a problem while encoding and decoding to and
from an Object stream.
items.translation: 指示在对象流中进行编码和解码时出现问题的通用错误。

items.source:
Indicates an issue with decoding the input stream with a focus on content
related issues such as a parse failure.
items.translation: 指示输入流解码存在问题，重点关注内容相关问题，例如解析失败。

items.source:
Indicates an issue with encoding the input Object stream with a focus on
not being able to encode Objects.
items.translation: 指示在编码输入对象流时出现问题，重点是无法编码对象。

items.source: Base class for exceptions thrown by the conversion system.
items.translation: 转换系统抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when an actual type conversion attempt fails.
items.translation: 当实际类型转换尝试失败时要抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception to be thrown when a suitable converter could not be found
in a given conversion service.
items.translation: 当在指定的转换服务中找不到合适的转换器时，将抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on failure to acquire a lock during an update,
for example during a "select for update" statement.
items.translation: 更新期间获取锁失败时抛出异常，例如在“select for update"语句期间。

items.source: Exception thrown on various data access concurrency failures.
items.translation: 在多种数据访问并发故障时抛出异常。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a resource fails completely:
for example, if we can't connect to a database using JDBC.
items.translation: 资源完全失败时抛出数据访问异常：例如，如果无法使用 JDBC 连接到数据库。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an attempt to execute an SQL statement fails to map
the given data, typically but no limited to an insert or update data
results in violation of an integrity constraint.
items.translation: 执行 SQL 语句时，若尝试映射给定数据失败，通常会抛出异常（但不限于此），例如插入或更新数据导致违反完整性约束。

items.source:
Exception thrown if certain expected data could not be retrieved, for example,
when looking up specific data via a known identifier.
items.translation: 如果无法检索某些预期数据，则抛出异常，例如通过已知标识符查找特定数据时。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an attempt to insert or update data
results in violation of a primary key or unique constraint.
items.translation: 尝试插入或更新数据时，如果违反了主键或唯一约束，将抛出异常。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a result was expected to have at least
one row (or element) but zero rows (or elements) were actually returned.
items.translation: 当预期结果至少包含一行（或一个元素），但实际返回零行（或零个元素）时，会抛出数据访问异常。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a result was not of the expected size,
for example when expecting a single row but getting 0 or more than 1 rows.
items.translation: 当结果的大小不符合预期时抛出数据访问异常，例如期望获取单行但实际得到 0 行或多于 1 行。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when something unintended appears to have
happened with an update, but the transaction hasn't already been rolled back.
items.translation: 更新操作出现意外情况时抛出数据访问异常，但事务尚未回滚。

items.source:
Exception thrown on incorrect usage of the API, such as failing to
"compile" a query object that needed compilation before execution.
items.translation: 在错误使用 API 时抛出异常，例如在执行之前未对需要编译的查询对象进行“编译”。

items.source: Root for exceptions thrown when we use a data access resource incorrectly.
items.translation: 用于在使用数据访问资源不正确时抛出异常的根异常。

items.source:
Root of the hierarchy of data access exceptions that are considered non-transient -
where a retry of the same operation would fail unless the cause of the Exception
is corrected.
items.translation: 数据访问异常层次结构中表示非瞬态异常的根节点——除非修正了异常的原因，否则重试同一操作将会失败。

items.source: Data access exception thrown when a resource fails completely and the failure is permanent.
items.translation: 资源完全失败且该失败为永久性时，会抛出数据访问异常。

items.source: Exception thrown on an optimistic locking violation.
items.translation: 在乐观锁冲突时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the underlying resource denied a permission
to access a specific element, such as a specific database table.
items.translation: 当底层资源拒绝访问特定元素（如特定数据库表）的权限时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown on a pessimistic locking violation.
items.translation: 在悲观锁冲突时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception to be thrown on a query timeout.
items.translation: 查询超时时要抛出的异常。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a previously failed operation might be able
to succeed if the application performs some recovery steps and retries the entire
transaction or in the case of a distributed transaction, the transaction branch.
items.translation: 当先前失败的操作在应用程序执行某些恢复步骤并重试整个事务（或在分布式事务的情况下，重试事务分支）后可能能够成功时，会抛出数据访问异常。

items.source:
Root of the hierarchy of data access exceptions that are considered transient -
where a previously failed operation might be able to succeed when the operation
is retried without any intervention by application-level functionality.
items.translation: 数据访问异常层次结构中被视为瞬态的根——在此情况下，先前失败的操作用于重试时可能会成功，而无需应用程序级功能的任何干预。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a resource fails temporarily
and the operation can be retried.
items.translation: 资源暂时失败且操作可重试时抛出数据访问异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on mismatch between Java type and database type:
for example on an attempt to set an object of the wrong type
in an RDBMS column.
items.translation: 在 Java 类型与数据库类型不匹配时抛出异常：例如，尝试在关系型数据库管理系统 (RDBMS) 列中设置错误类型的对象。

items.source:
Normal superclass when we can't distinguish anything more specific
than "something went wrong with the underlying resource": for example,
an SQLException from JDBC we can't pinpoint more precisely.
items.translation: 当无法区分比“底层资源出现问题”更具体的情况时，使用普通的父类：例如，来自 JDBC 且无法精确定位的 SQLException。

items.source: Fatal exception thrown when we can't connect to an RDBMS using JDBC.
items.translation: 使用 JDBC 无法连接到 RDBMS 时抛出致命异常。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a result set did not have the correct column count,
for example when expecting a single column but getting 0 or more than 1 column.
items.translation: 当结果集没有正确的列数时抛出数据访问异常，例如期望单列但得到 0 列或多于 1 列。

items.source: Exception thrown when a ResultSet has been accessed in an invalid fashion.
items.translation: 当以无效方式访问 ResultSet 时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a JDBC update affects an unexpected number of rows.
items.translation: 当 JDBC 更新影响的行数与预期不符时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when we can't classify an SQLException into
one of our generic data access exceptions.
items.translation: 抛出异常的情况是我们无法将 SQLException 分类为通用数据访问异常之一时。

items.source:
Exception to be thrown by a DataSourceLookup implementation,
indicating that the specified DataSource could not be obtained.
items.translation: 由 DataSourceLookup 实现抛出的异常，表示无法获取指定的 DataSource。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS 的 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidClientIDException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidClientIDException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidDestinationException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidDestinationException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidSelectorException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidSelectorException。

items.source:
Base class for exception thrown by the framework whenever it
encounters a problem related to JMS.
items.translation: 框架在遇到任何与 JMS 相关的问题时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS JMSSecurityException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS 的 JMSSecurityException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageEOFException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageEOFException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageFormatException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageFormatException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageNotReadableException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageNotReadableException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageNotWriteableException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageNotWriteableException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS ResourceAllocationException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS ResourceAllocationException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS TransactionInProgressException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMSTransactionInProgressException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS TransactionRolledBackException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMSTransactionRolledBackException。

items.source: JmsException to be thrown when no other matching subclass found.
items.translation: 当找不到其他匹配的子类时，将抛出 JmsException。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a synchronized local transaction failed to complete
(after the main transaction has already completed).
items.translation: 主事务完成后，同步本地事务未能完成时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when the execution of a listener method failed.
items.translation: 当监听器方法执行失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when the reply of a message failed to be sent.
items.translation: 消息回复发送失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: Thrown by a DestinationResolver when it cannot resolve a destination name.
items.translation: 由 DestinationResolver 抛出，当它无法解析目的地名称时。

items.source: General base exception to be thrown on JMX errors.
items.translation: JMX 错误中要抛出的通用基异常。

items.source:
Thrown when an invocation on an MBean resource failed with an exception (either
a reflection exception or an exception thrown by the target method itself).
items.translation: 当对 MBean 资源的调用因异常（无论是反射异常还是目标方法本身抛出的异常）而失败时抛出。

items.source:
Thrown when an invocation failed because of an I/O problem on the
MBeanServerConnection.
items.translation: 当 MBeanServerConnection 上发生 I/O 问题导致调用失败时抛出此异常。

items.source:
Thrown if an exception is encountered when trying to retrieve
MBean metadata.
items.translation: 在尝试检索 MBean 元数据时遇到异常时抛出。

items.source: Exception thrown in case of failure when exporting an MBean.
items.translation: 导出 MBean 失败时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when we are unable to register an MBean,
for example because of a naming conflict.
items.translation: 无法注册 MBean 时抛出异常，例如由于命名冲突。

items.source: Exception thrown on failed authentication.
items.translation: 认证失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Base class for all mail exceptions.
items.translation: 所有邮件异常的基类。

items.source: Exception thrown if illegal message properties are encountered.
items.translation: 遇到非法消息属性时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception to be thrown by user code if a mail cannot be prepared properly,
for example when a FreeMarker template cannot be rendered for the mail text.
items.translation: 用户代码在邮件无法正确准备时抛出的异常，例如当无法为邮件文本渲染 FreeMarker 模板时。

items.source: Exception thrown when a mail sending error is encountered.
items.translation: 遇到邮件发送错误时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception that indicates an error occurred during message delivery.
items.translation: 指示消息传递期间发生错误的异常。

items.source: Exception that indicates an error occurred during message handling.
items.translation: 指示消息处理期间发生错误的异常。

items.source: The base exception for any failures related to messaging.
items.translation: 与消息传递相关的任何失败的基异常。

items.source: Exception that indicates that a method argument has not the expected type.
items.translation: 指示方法参数未具有预期类型的异常。

items.source: Raised after a failure to encode or decode a STOMP message.
items.translation: 在无法对 STOMP 消息进行编码或解码后抛出。

items.source: Exception thrown on an optimistic locking violation for a mapped object.
items.translation: 在映射对象上因乐观锁冲突而抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown if a mapped object could not be retrieved via its identifier.
items.translation: 如果无法通过标识符检索映射对象，则抛出异常。

items.source: JPA-specific subclass of ObjectRetrievalFailureException.
items.translation: ObjectRetrievalFailureException 的 JPA 专用子类。

items.source: JPA-specific subclass of ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException.
items.translation: ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException 的 JPA 专用子类。

items.source: Base class for exception thrown when a marshalling or unmarshalling error occurs.
items.translation: 抛出序列化或反序列化错误时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Exception thrown on marshalling failure.
items.translation: 在反序列化失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception that indicates that the cause cannot be distinguished further.
items.translation: 表示无法进一步区分原因的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown on unmarshalling failure.
items.translation: 反序列化失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown on marshalling validation failure.
items.translation: 在反序列化验证失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Root of the hierarchy of Object XML Mapping exceptions.
items.translation: Object XML 映射异常层次结构的根。

items.source:
General exception to be thrown on scheduling failures,
such as the scheduler already having shut down.
items.translation: 调度失败时抛出的通用异常，例如调度器已经关闭。

items.source: Unchecked exception that wraps an exception thrown from a target method.
items.translation: 包装从目标方法抛出的异常的 unchecked 异常。

items.source: Exception to be thrown on script compilation failure.
items.translation: 脚本编译失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception to be thrown on script execution failure.
items.translation: 脚本执行失败时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a transaction can't be created using an
underlying transaction API such as JTA.
items.translation: 使用底层事务 API（如 JTA）创建事务时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception that represents a transaction failure caused by a heuristic
decision on the side of the transaction coordinator.
items.translation: 表示由事务协调器侧的启发式决策导致的事务失败的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the existence or non-existence of a transaction
amounts to an illegal state according to the transaction propagation
behavior that applies.
items.translation: 当事务的存在或不存在根据适用的事务传播行为构成非法状态时，抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an invalid isolation level is specified,
i.e.
items.translation: 当指定了无效的隔离级别时抛出的异常，即

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an invalid timeout is specified,
that is, the specified timeout valid is out of range or the
transaction manager implementation doesn't support timeouts.
items.translation: 当指定了无效的超时时间时抛出的异常，即指定的超时值超出范围或事务管理器实现不支持超时。

items.source:
Exception thrown when attempting to work with a nested transaction
but nested transactions are not supported by the underlying backend.
items.translation: 尝试处理嵌套事务时抛出异常，但底层后端不支持嵌套事务。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an operation is attempted that
relies on an existing transaction (such as setting
rollback status) and there is no existing transaction.
items.translation: 当尝试执行依赖于现有事务的操作（例如设置回滚状态）且不存在现有事务时，会抛出异常。

items.source: Superclass for all transaction exceptions.
items.translation: 所有事务异常的超类。

items.source:
Exception thrown when attempting to suspend an existing transaction
but transaction suspension is not supported by the underlying backend.
items.translation: 尝试挂起现有事务时抛出异常，但底层后端不支持事务挂起。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a general transaction system error is encountered,
like on commit or rollback.
items.translation: 当遇到通用事务系统错误时抛出异常，例如在提交或回滚时。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when a transaction has timed out.
items.translation: 当事务超时时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Superclass for exceptions caused by inappropriate usage of
a Spring transaction API.
items.translation: 由不当使用 Spring 事务 API 引起的异常的超类。

items.source:
Thrown when an attempt to commit a transaction resulted
in an unexpected rollback.
items.translation: 当尝试提交事务导致意外回滚时抛出。

items.source:
Exception raised when an API version cannot be parsed, or is not in the
supported version set.
items.translation: 当无法解析 API 版本或该版本不在支持的版本集合中时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception raised when an API version is required, but is not present.
items.translation: 当需要 API 版本但未提供时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Exception raised when an API version is valid, but did not match the versions
declared in request mappings for the endpoint.
items.translation: 当 API 版本有效但与端点请求映射中声明的版本不匹配时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when an HTTP 4xx is received.
items.translation: 收到 HTTP 4xx 响应时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when an HTTP 5xx is received.
items.translation: 收到 HTTP 5xx 错误时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when an I/O error occurs.
items.translation: 发生 I/O 错误时抛出异常。

items.source: Common base class for exceptions that contain actual HTTP response data.
items.translation: 包含实际 HTTP 响应数据的异常通用基类。

items.source: A ConversionNotSupportedException raised while resolving a method argument.
items.translation: 解析方法参数时抛出 ConversionNotSupportedException。

items.source: A TypeMismatchException raised while resolving a controller method argument.
items.translation: 在解析控制器方法参数时抛出 TypeMismatchException。

items.source:
MultipartException subclass thrown when an upload exceeds the
maximum upload size allowed.
items.translation: 当上传超过允许的最大大小时，会抛出 MultipartException 子类异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when multipart resolution fails.
items.translation: 当多部分解析失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Exceptions that contain actual HTTP request data.
items.translation: 包含实际 HTTP 请求数据的异常。

items.source: Exceptions that contain actual HTTP response data.
items.translation: 包含实际 HTTP 响应数据的异常。

items.source:
Exception for errors that fit response status 413 (Content too large) for use in
Spring Web applications.
items.translation: 适用于 Spring Web 应用程序的、符合响应状态 413（内容过大）的错误。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 405 (method not allowed).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 405（方法不允许）的错误的异常。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 406 (not acceptable).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 406（不可接受）错误的异常。

items.source:
Exception for errors that fit response status 400 (bad request) for use in
Spring Web applications.
items.translation: 适用于 Spring Web 应用程序的、用于响应状态码为 400（请求无效）错误的异常。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 415 (unsupported media type).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 415（不支持的媒体类型）错误的异常。

items.source:
Thrown when handshake processing failed to complete due to an internal, unrecoverable
error.
items.translation: 当握手处理因内部不可恢复的错误而无法完成时抛出。

items.source: Base class for exceptions raised while processing SockJS HTTP requests.
items.translation: 处理 SockJS HTTP 请求时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source:
An exception thrown when a message frame was successfully received over an HTTP POST
and parsed but one or more of the messages it contained could not be delivered to the
WebSocketHandler either because the handler failed or because the connection got
closed.
items.translation: 当通过 HTTP POST 成功接收并解析消息帧，但其中一条或多条消息无法投递到 WebSocketHandler（因为处理器失败或连接已关闭）时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Indicates a serious failure that occurred in the SockJS implementation as opposed to
in user code (for example, IOException while writing to the response).
items.translation: 指示在 SockJS 实现中发生的严重故障，而不是在用户代码中（例如，向响应写入时发生 IOException）。
